model_system: single-orbital nearest-neighbor Kagome lattice model for AV3Sb5 at 5/4 van Hove filling with 2x2 3Q chiral flux order

key_params.hall_formula: intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity from Kubo formula

headline_claim: For lambda=0.3, the chiral flux phase has the lowest energy: 0.195 t below CBO and 0.435 t below vCDW per unit cell; its occupied bands give C=1 per spin sector and sigma_xy=2 e^2/h in the single-orbital model.
replication_difficulty: medium — simple model and observables, but requires correctly building the 2x2 CFP pattern, enforcing current conservation, diagonalizing folded bands, and evaluating Kubo/Chern numbers.
